description: Rank candidate strategies by what they add to a book: independent bets added first, then how they behave on the book's worst days, with return shown last and never used to rank. Correlation first.

book_file.description: A CSV of the book's daily returns: date, then one column per strategy or one for the whole book.

candidates_file.description: A CSV of candidates' daily returns: date, then one column each.

min_days.description: Days a candidate must share with the book; default 252.

name: find_diversifiers
title: Find what diversifies a book
